heading: Professional Experience
intro: Six years of shipping interfaces, architecture and the odd AI experiment.

entries.summary: Architected and scaled P&O Cruises' digital booking platform, driving platform modernization through micro-frontends, enterprise integrations, AI-enabled engineering workflows, and developer excellence initiatives.
bullets: Architected and delivered a scalable **Next.js** booking platform for Carnival, decomposing the experience into a **micro-frontend** system built on **Atomic Design** principles so squads ship modular, independently deployable journeys without cross-team release coordination.

Integrated **React** frontends with **Python FastAPI** services through standardized **RESTful** endpoints for pricing, availability and itinerary features, partnering with backend teams on **OpenAPI** contracts, request validation and error-handling conventions.

Containerized the Next.js application with **Docker** and deployed it on **AWS ECS** through a **CI/CD** pipeline, serving static assets via **S3** and **CloudFront** while **AEM** remained the headless content source, which let each squad release its journeys independently of AEM content publishing.
Integrated **AEM content fragments** and **GraphQL** into the frontend architecture, powering dynamic content delivery and enterprise data integration across the booking journey.
Built reusable **AI-enabled engineering workflows** that let developers apply AI consistently across the platform while preserving code quality, security standards and architectural integrity.

entries.summary: Engineered and modernized multi-tenant fulfilment and location pages for three leading restaurant brands, driving scalable architecture and improved customer engagement
bullets: Engineered **multi-tenant** fulfilment and location services powering Buffalo Wild Wings, Sonic, and Arby's, serving thousands of monthly active users across 3 brands from a shared React and Next.js codebase.

Architected a **Node.js/Express BFF layer** that consolidated downstream API calls into tenant-specific responses, reducing client-side network overhead and eliminating sensitive fields from browser exposed payloads

Led the modernization of fulfilment and location services, resulting in a **30% increase in user engagement time** and improved customer satisfaction through faster page loads and optimized user journeys.
Integrated **Contentful CMS** for dynamic multi-brand content orchestration, enabling marketing to ship campaigns without engineering deploys and significantly reducing content lead time.
Instrumented **New Relic and Google Analytics** monitoring across Core Web Vitals and conversion funnels, proactively identifying and resolving performance regressions

entries.summary: Led Monolith-to-Micro-Frontend Migration for Core Banking Platform
bullets: Implemented **Micro Frontend (MFE) architecture** using React, modularizing a monolithic application into independently deployable units, enabling parallel development across teams
Led frontend modernization and version upgrades, resolving critical **legacy technical debt** and establishing **modular coding patterns** across modules
Improved **Lighthouse score by 25%** through code optimization, performance monitoring, and efficient resource management.

Implemented dynamic menu options and **conditional rendering based on user roles** (admin, financial analysts, customer support, and end-users) using React.js, Redux tool kit and Context API, ensuring a secure and customized user experience.
Deployed frontend apps using **Jenkins and EVOLVE(Cloud Orchestration on AWS)**. Optimized components for **maximum performance** across browsers.
Adhered to **secure coding practices**, mitigating vulnerabilities and ensuring compliance with banking security policies.

Gained hands-on experience in the **fintech domain**, working on **banking applications** that required adherence to strict security, compliance, and performance standards. Developed a deep understanding of financial workflows and user expectations.

entries.summary: Developed and enhanced enterprise DevOps platform capabilities through component-driven architecture, GraphQL integration, UI standardization.
bullets: Developed the user interface for the **myWizard DevOps platform** using **React.js**, translating design specifications into production-quality, responsive interfaces.

Led design and development of a scalable **React component library** adopted across 4 platform modules; drove UI/UX standardization and reduced duplicate implementations across engineering teams, improving development velocity and code consistency.
Integrated **GraphQL** in collaboration with backend teams, owning **data-fetching architecture**, **error handling**, and **loading-state patterns**.
Received the **Accenture Wall of Fame Award (2021)** for delivery impact on the **DevOps platform** within the first year of joining.
